content: Donna Eden is an author, lecturer, and educator specializing in the field of energy medicine. She frequently collaborates with her husband, David Feinstein, PhD, who is a former faculty member of The Johns Hopkins University School of Medicine. Together, they co-authored the bestselling book Energy Medicine. They also co-wrote Six Pillars of Energy Medicine: Clinical Strengths of a Complementary Paradigm, which was published in the peer-reviewed journal Alternative Therapies in Health and Medicine. Donna Eden is a faculty member at the Energy Medicine University. She coined and trademarked the term Energy Kinesiology, which refers to a method of using muscle testing to identify and correct imbalances in the body. In May 2002, she granted unrestricted rights to use this term to the Energy Kinesiology Association. Additionally, she co-founded the nonprofit Energy Medicine Institute in Ashland, Oregon. The Eden Energy Medicine Certification Program is based on her work. Donna Eden's practice focuses on energy healing, and she has shared her concepts of energy medicine across the United States. These practices are often categorized under alternative medicine. She claims to possess the ability to perceive the body's energy systems and uses this skill to accurately diagnose the underlying causes of physical and psychological issues. Based on her observations, she develops highly effective treatment protocols. Her bibliography includes the following works: Energy Medicine (paperback, co-authored with David Feinstein), published by Jeremy P. Tarcher/Putnam in 1998, ISBN 978-1585420216. The Energy Medicine Kit (kit edition, paperback), published by Sounds True in 2005, ISBN 978-1591792086. The Promise of Energy Psychology: Revolutionary Tools for Dramatic Personal Change (paperback, co-authored with David Feinstein and Gary Craig), published by Jeremy P. Tarcher/Penguin in 2005, ISBN 978-1585424429. Energy Medicine for Women: Aligning Your Body's Energies to Boost Your Health and Vitality (paperback), published by Penguin Group (USA) Inc. in 2008, ISBN 978-1585426478. Her work has been recognized in various contexts, including being ranked 3 on Amazon's bestseller list in the category of Health, Mind & Body > Alternative Medicine > Energy Healing as of January 27, 2008. Her contributions have also been cited in peer-reviewed journals, such as Alternative Therapies in Health and Medicine (2008, 14(1), 44-54), and in other publications like The Handbook of Humanistic Psychology and Essentials of Managing Stress.
